summary: Revise at 6.6. Earlier rounds scored 5.6, 6.2 and 6.3. Caiman scores 7 and the ship bar is 7.5. This is round 4 of the five Logan granted, judged as lost wax. Two things block a ship. (A) The template gate is missing. Rounds 2 and 3 recorded it in verification.json. This commit deletes verification.json and template.graph.json, and the design has grown to 1,187,986 bytes, over the 1 MB stock budget. A gate the JSON does not record is an automatic revise. (B) The art is still below the bar. The face is much better. The 7.5 mm face leaves (placed.face_leaf_mm [7.5, 7.5]) are now pillowed blades with crisp true outlines, a midrib and vein strokes. They no longer fold into a dark notch. One stipple field now covers the table with polished halos round every leaf and berry, so the round 1-3 rectangular panels are gone. At 300 px the ring reads as holly with no caption. The rest of the ring has not caught up. (1) The cheeks went backwards. Each end wall again carries a straight row of three berries (theta 81.56/90/98.44, v within 0.05 mm of each other), the 'rivets in a row' that round 1 punched and round 2 fixed. There are two thin, wafer-walled leaves, not three, and the end wall behind the berries is lumpy and swollen (cheek.png). (2) The garland is still flat, vertical-walled bat-shaped plates. They are now splayed +/-25 deg, but on a stem of struck capsules whose joints show (garland.png). The stem stands 0.2 mm proud (0.3 asked), and the stems and leaves end in stubs at the palm. (3) The face leaves stand only 0.35 mm (0.8 was asked in rounds 1-3), so face-on (face.png) they still read as flat bat silhouettes. A horizontal seam with small notches at the stem ends crosses each leaf on the parting line. (4) The stipple is a coarse hammered pebble, not a fine matte. It smears into combed streaks at the table inset edge (leaf.png). On the shoulders it renders as large triangulated facets with a ragged, combed upper border. In the hero view it reads as scattered dashes. (5) The shank still shows the stock's banding (palm.png), and most of the ring outside the face is bare polish or flat cut-outs, well under the density of Caiman or the Reptilia sheet. Round 5 can reach 7.5 only if it fixes the cheeks, the garland's modelling and the stipple scale, and restores the template record.
strengths: Face leaves at last at 7.5 mm with a pillow top: one lit blade top and bottom, no dark notch under the parting line (leaf.png, stones.png).
True, crisp leaf outlines: the spines are clean points, and no stair-steps show on the face-leaf margins.
One stipple field over the whole table, with masked polished halos round the leaves and berries. The two-panel box is gone.
The face berry triangle in made gypsy-mound seats with a hairline stalk joining it to the leaves reads as a holly sprig at 300 px with no caption.
The native 006 at 19.2 x 17 keeps a flat table and the factory's hard wall-to-face angles (bare-vs-finished.png).
The garland now alternates +/-25 deg, as round 2 and 3 asked.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: Holly runs across the face, the cheeks and the shoulders, and the palm is bare as the plan says. The stipple is a field treatment, not a stray motif.

checklist.item: Reads as its plant at 300 px without caption
checklist.reason: hero-300 and face-300: spined leaves flanking a three-berry cluster say holly. Face-on, the low leaves still lean toward bat silhouettes.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true, crisp outlines
checklist.reason: The face-leaf outlines are crisp, but a parting-line seam with notches crosses each face leaf (face.png). The garland stem shows capsule joints and the garland leaves are flat-walled plates (garland.png). The stipple combs and smears at the table inset edge (leaf.png) and along the shoulder band border.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, visible, coloured as fruit
checklist.reason: Nine garnets in gypsy-mound seats, all visible and berry-red. But each cheek's berries are back in a straight row of three (theta 81.56/90/98.44, v 16.39-16.44 and 2.63-2.65). That is the rivet row round 1 punched; it reads as studs, not a bunch.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: The face leaves are pillowed but only 0.35 mm tall. The cheek leaves (0.3 mm) and garland leaves (0.3 mm) are flat plates with vertical walls. The garland stem is a chain of capsules. The cheek end wall behind the berries is distorted into lumps (cheek.png).

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Native 006 with no sand master: the table-to-wall edges are crisp in hero.png and bare-vs-finished.png.

checklist.item: Silhouette distinct from other Vepres rings
checklist.reason: The only square signet in Vepres so far: a flat 19.2 x 17 table with a parting-line garland. No other Vepres ring is rendered in showcase/vepres/.

checklist.item: Large, medium, small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large (face leaves) and small (berries, veins) are present, but the medium tier is thin: two small leaves a cheek and plate-like garland leaves. The shank flanks below the garland and the palm are bare polish with stock banding. That is far less worked than Caiman or Varanus.

gates.verified: process 'Lost wax' at coarse, draft and export; min_section_mm 0.8
watertight true, degenerate_faces 0, boundary and non-manifold edges 0 at 384x192, 768x320 and 1536x448. min_angle_deg 0.0005 shows sliver triangles, but none degenerate.

gates.gate: 0 self-crossings on ring and every made part
gates.verified: self_crossings 0 at all three builds; made_parts []
solids_notes [] and parts_notes [] at all builds
bore_margin_mm -0.0021 at every build: 2 microns of tessellation noise, inside the author's 0.01 tolerance. Round 3 recorded -4.8e-7, so the margin got worse; worth tightening.
field_verdict 'Castable' at all builds; undercut 0.024% (worst 8.4 deg, at face berries 2 and 3), allowed for investment casting

field thinnest_wall_mm 1.349 at all builds. But the ray-cast wall measure on the coarse build (wall_rays) reports 38 of 384 rays below 0.8 mm, with a sampled minimum of 0.022 mm. It is computed and never gated, and it records no location. It is most likely rays crossing thin relief or sliver triangles, but it is unexplained.

gates.claimed: Not gated for lost wax; reported as sand_bonus
gates.verified: Replaced by the wall gate per the instructions. For the record: 140 / 187 obstructions, 0 unresolved, and most garland and face stamps not monotone. sand_bonus.pulls_from_sand_as_is false.

gates.gate: Stone count equals preview; no metal in stones
gates.verified: stones_reported 9, stones_previewed 9; metal_inside_stones 0 for all 9; closest stones 0.26 mm (Cheek berry 2, 2 to 2, 3)

gates.gate: Template gate (<= 4 design.set patches, byte-identical cold lift, within class budget)
gates.verified: Not recorded. Commit 2950a4a deletes showcase/vepres/ilex/verification.json and template.graph.json, both present in rounds 2-3, and report.json carries no template block. design_bytes 1,187,986 exceeds the 1 MB stock budget (flag at 3 MB).

punch_list.change: Re-run the template lift on the round 4/5 design and commit both files. Record a byte-identical cold evaluation, at most 4 design.set patches, size and open time. Bring the lift under the 1 MB stock budget (round 3 was 805,533 bytes): drop the redundant capsule-chain stem stamps (punch 4 replaces them with one sweep) and any duplicated stipple masks.
punch_list.acceptance: verification.json exists with patches <= 4, cold lift identical true, and size <= 1,000,000 bytes.

punch_list.zone: Cheek sprays on both end walls: 'Cheek berry 1/2, 1-3' (theta 81.56/90/98.44) and 'Cheek leaf 1/2, 1-2' (theta 66.62/113.38)
punch_list.change: Undo the regression. Regroup each cheek's three berries into a touching triangle as in round 2: centre berry 0.9 mm toward the table, outer pair 0.9 mm toward the bore, with girdle gaps 0.2-0.3 mm. Add the planned third leaf per cheek, pointing toward the bore below the bunch. Grow the cheek leaves to 6.0 x 3.2 mm, raise them from 0.3 to 0.5 mm, and give them the face leaves' pillow top. Find and remove the source of the lumpy swelling on the end wall behind the berries (seat skirts or mound blend overlapping): the wall between motifs must stay flat polish.
punch_list.acceptance: cheek.png and side.png: a triangle bunch framed by three domed leaves, no straight row, and the end wall smooth around them. report.json placed.cheek shows berry v values differing by >= 0.8 mm within a bunch, and 3 leaves per cheek.

punch_list.change: Raise height_mm from 0.35 to 0.7 (the lost-wax ruling removes the pull reason for keeping them low) and keep the pillow top. Remove the horizontal seam and the small notches at the stem ends where each leaf crosses the parting line: strike each leaf as one piece, not two halves. Deepen the midrib bench cut from 0.1 to 0.2 mm, round-bottomed.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png: no horizontal line or notch across either leaf; face-on the leaves show a lit dome with shadowed margins, not a flat silhouette. report.json stamps 'Face leaf, 1/2' height_mm >= 0.7.

punch_list.zone: Shoulder garland: 'Garland leaf, left/right 1-7' and 'Garland stem, left/right 1-14' (theta 49 to -48 and 131 to 228)
punch_list.change: Replace the 14 struck capsules a side with one continuous swept stem (cad::twist or a 3-D Sweep), 0.6 mm wide, 0.3 mm proud, round-sectioned, tapering to 0.4 mm and ending in a tendril or leaf tip before the palm, not in a stub. Give each garland leaf a pillow top (0.2 mm rise) and raise it from 0.3 to 0.45 mm so it reads as a curved blade, not a cut plate.
punch_list.acceptance: garland.png and reverse.png: one smooth stem with no visible joints; the leaves read as domed and splayed off it; palm.png shows the garland ending cleanly.

punch_list.change: Scale the stipple down to a fine matte: cell size about a third of the current one (aim for 0.25-0.35 mm cells), height 0.03-0.04 mm, sampled at the export chart's resolution so it renders without triangulated facets. Soften the 0.8 mm inset edge on the table with a 0.3 mm feather so it does not comb. Give the shoulder band a clean, feathered border.
punch_list.acceptance: leaf.png and face.png: an even fine matte with no streaks at the inset edge. garland.png: no large triangular facets and no ragged or combed border on the shoulder band. hero.png: the field reads as a uniform matte, not scattered dashes.

punch_list.zone: Shank flanks below the garland and the stock banding (palm.png)
punch_list.change: Smooth the stock's horizontal banding at export (refine or relax the native 006 shank tessellation). Run the shoulder stipple down to 3 mm short of the palm so the medium-to-small texture reaches Caiman's density, and keep the palm bare.
punch_list.acceptance: palm.png and reverse.png: no horizontal banding in the reflections, and the flanks carry fine matte until the bare palm.

punch_list.zone: Lost-wax wall record (report.json wall_rays) and bore margin
punch_list.change: Record the location of each wall_rays sample below 0.8 mm. Show they are relief or sliver artefacts, or thicken what is real. Bring bore_margin_mm back to >= -0.0005 (round 3 level) by trimming whatever stamp or seat reaches into the bore.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json: wall_rays below_limit explained per point, with no band-section sample under 0.8 mm, and bore_margin_mm >= -0.0005 at all builds.
